concept.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: character concept sheet for the Knight's Wish village and city builder. Input image is a STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY: the warm timber, cream plaster, terracotta, slate, ochre, teal, and blue-gold fantasy village. Create a NEW wide concept sheet on a quiet warm cream background with four equally spaced columns. Each column has one large full-body standing citizen at a slight three-quarter front view, and one smaller working-action study below; show the entire figure and tools with generous separation. Exactly four distinct villagers: BUILDER — sturdy adult brickmaker, cream rolled-sleeve shirt, terracotta leather apron, slate cloth cap, brown boots, trowel and one red clay brick; FARMER — practical adult woman, broad straw hat, cream blouse, muted sage skirt/trousers, ochre belt, wooden hoe and wheat sheaf; PORTER — wiry adult man, ochre vest over cream shirt, slate trousers, small teal scarf, brown boots, carrying a compact wooden crate; ARCANIST — adult woman in a short teal work robe with cream sleeves and gold trim, brown boots, dark hair tied back, holding a small cyan crystal and shaping a restrained luminous rune. Friendly capable working people, diverse faces and skin tones, grounded medieval tools, no armour or battle poses. Painterly pixel-art concept treatment with deliberate crisp stepped silhouettes, tactile materials and warm upper-left lighting, matching the provided village's art direction. The four labels may appear once above their columns exactly: BUILDER, FARMER, PORTER, ARCANIST. No other text, no decorative borders, no UI, no scenery, no photorealism. This is the concept stage for later tiny animated sprites: make their clothing silhouettes and colours clear and consistent between their two studies.

animations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art animation atlas for the Knight's Wish village builder. Reference image: use ONLY the named citizen's appearance from the supplied concept sheet; it is a character identity and colour reference, not a layout to copy. Create ONE transparent landscape sprite sheet in a precise invisible 4-column by 2-row grid, exactly EIGHT complete sprites, one per equally sized cell. Top row is a FOUR-FRAME WALK loop, bottom row a FOUR-FRAME WORK loop. Every frame faces the same slight three-quarter front/right direction. Character designed as a readable 32-pixel-high game sprite, enlarged with crisp square pixel clusters and hard stepped outlines; simpler than the concept, no smooth painting, no anti-aliased sketch lines. Same head, clothes, body proportions and size in all8 frames. Feet share the same baseline at85% cell height. Standing head top at25% cell height; walking may bob by only one logical pixel. Keep20% clear side margins and all tools/hands inside each cell. Every sprite is isolated on genuine transparent alpha. No text, labels, grid lines, frames, floor tiles, scenery, UI, cast shadows, duplicate extra people, or background colour. Clear distinct poses forming seamless cycles; fixed camera and lighting from upper-left.
Character: the BUILDER from the concept: stocky adult man with moustache, slate cloth cap, cream rolled sleeves, terracotta apron, slate trousers and brown boots; right hand holds a small steel trowel. WALK frames left-to-right: left foot forward, passing pose, right foot forward, opposite passing pose; carries one clay brick in left hand, subtle arm/leg counter-motion. WORK frames left-to-right: trowel poised beside a fixed small two-brick stack at front/right, trowel raised, torso slightly bent spreading mortar on the top brick, return pose. Work feet stay planted; the same tiny brick stack remains in every work frame. Tools and clothing do not change shape between frames.
